answer_1.quote: Paraphrase generation is the task of generating an output sentence which is semantically identical to a given input sentence but with variations in lexicon or syntax.

answer_2.quote: We evaluate all models using BLEU, iBLEU and ROUGE scores.

answer_4.quote: We assign the input sentence and its generated paraphrase to three human annotators at Amazon Mechanical Turk (AMT), with "> 95% HIT approval rate". Turkers are asked to evaluate the quality of generated paraphrases by considering three aspects semantics, diversity and fluency, as detailed in Section 3.3.4.
answer_4.guideline: Turkers are asked to evaluate the quality of generated paraphrases by considering three aspects semantics, diversity and fluency.
